events.name: New York Mets at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Marcus Semien hit a three-run homer, rookie Zac Thornton pitched five scoreless innings and the New York Mets matched a season high with their fourth straight win by beating the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marcus Semien and Zac Thornton lead Mets to their 4th straight victory, 6-4 over sliding Pirates

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Toronto reliever Tyler Rogers allowed two runs in the ninth inning after he twice loaded the bases and retired All-Star outfielder Brandon Marsh on a groundout to end the game and preserve the Blue Jays' 5-4 win over the Philadelphia Phillies on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Rogers escapes 2 bases-loaded jams in the 9th to seal the Blue Jays' 5-4 win over the Phillies

headlines.description: — Daylen Lile and Harry Ford homered for Washington, and the Nationals beat the Cincinnati Reds 5-3 on Friday night for just their second win in the last 10 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lile and Ford homer to give the Nationals all their runs in a 5-3 victory over the Reds

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ben Rice ripped a tying single off the right-field fence with two outs in the ninth inning and Ryan McMahon hit a game-winning sacrifice fly in the 10th as the New York Yankees rallied past the Atlanta Braves 3-2 on Friday night in a rain-delayed...
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees rally with 2 outs in 9th inning and beat Braves 3-2 in 10 after long rain delay

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Mike Trout and Nolan Schanuel both hit home runs for the Los Angeles Angels in a 4-3 win over the Marlins to open the series on Friday night, Miami's fourth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trout and Schanuel homer in Angels 4-3 win over Marlins

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 in six innings, Wilyer Abreu drove in three runs, and the Boston Red Sox won their ninth game in a row with a 13-1 rout of the Athletics on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tolle has career-high 14 strikeouts, Red Sox beat A's 13-1 for 9th straight win

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Angel Martínez hit a grand slam and drove in a career-high six runs and the Cleveland Guardians beat the AL Central-leading Chicago White Sox 8-2 on Friday night to end a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martínez hits grand slam, has career-high 6 RBIs in Guardians' 8-2 win over White Sox

headlines.description: — Josh Bell went 4 for 5 with a homer and Kaelen Culpepper also went deep in his major league debut as the Minnesota Twins erased a four-run deficit and beat the Milwaukee Brewers 8-6 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Bell sparks comeback as Twins rally to beat Brewers, 8-6

events.name: Chicago Cubs at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Kevin Gausman provided exactly what the Cubs hoped for when they acquired him from the Blue Jays last weekend, pitching seven sharp innings in his Chicago debut in a 6-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kevin Gausman shines in his Cubs debut, pitching 7 sharp innings in a 6-4 win over the Royals

headlines.description: — Joc Pederson hit a two-run homer in the sixth inning and Nathan Eovaldi and three relievers combined to limit Baltimore to one run as the Texas Rangers beat the Orioles 2-1 Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joc Pederson's 2-run homer in the 6th lifts Rangers past the Orioles 2-1

events.name: Colorado Rockies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Iván Herrera hit a solo home run, Kyle Leahy pitched five innings and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Colorado Rockies 3-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herrera homers in the Cardinals' 3-2 win over the Rockies

events.name: Houston Astros at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Cam Smith homered twice and the AL West-leading Houston Astros spoiled Robbie Ray's San Diego debut by beating the Padres 6-3 on Friday night for their eighth win in 10 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Smith homers twice as Astros beat newcomer Robbie Ray, Padres 6-3

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Rookie Ryan Waldschmidt hit a two-run homer in the ninth inning off closer Edwin Diaz to give the Arizona Diamondbacks 4-3 victory over Los Angeles on Friday night, sending the Dodgers...
headlines.shortLinkText: Waldschmidt walks off LA with 2-run HR as D-backs hand Dodgers 7th straight loss

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Drew Rasmussen pitched seven shutout innings, Jonny DeLuca and Jonathan Aranda homered and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Seattle Mariners 2-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Rasmussen throws 7 scoreless innings as Rays beat Mariners 2-1

events.name: Detroit Tigers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers hit a two-run homer in the first, Jung Hoo Lee singled in two runs the next inning before Willy Adames homered in the fifth, and the San Francisco Giants beat the Detroit Tigers 5-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers, Willy Adames hit home runs, Jung Hoo Lee adds 2-run single as Giants beat Tigers 5-2
